AETIOLOGY OF VITAMIN A DEFICIENCY
- Malnutrition (the commonest cause of VAD in this part of the world)
- Inadequate intake
- Measles infection
- Increased risk of deficiency in: Fat malabsorption, Cystic fibrosis, Tropical
   sprue, Pancreatic insufficiency
- Inflammatory bowel disease, cholestasis, small bowel bypass surgery,
   vegans, refugees, recent immigrants
- Alcoholism, toddlers and pre-school children living below the poverty line
